# Configuration

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Every key of the configuration file, generated from `herdsman spec descriptor` and `herdsman spec proto`. Keys may be written with underscores or hyphens.

## [aliases]

Short command names, each expanding to a herdsman command line.

Type: table of string.

## [branch]

Branch controls how task branches are named.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | A template for the branch name. |
| `types` | array of string | The change types a branch name may start with. |

## [commit]

Commit controls commits the worktree layer makes.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `convention` | string | Names the message style the generator and the checks expect. |
| `stage` | `all` \| `tracked` \| `index` | StagePolicy says what a commit takes from the working tree. |

### [commit.generation]

CommitGeneration controls generated commit messages and branch summaries.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | string | "auto", or a program reading a prompt on stdin and printing the message. |
| `enabled` | boolean |  |
| `summary` | boolean | Whether branch listings show a generated one-line summary. |
| `template_append` | string | Added to the end of the prompt. |

## [hooks]

Hooks holds one optional hook for each point in a task's life.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `post_clean` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `post_commit` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `post_merge` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `post_start` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `post_switch` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `post_teardown` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_clean` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_commit` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_merge` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_start` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_switch` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |
| `pre_teardown` | string, table or array | HookSpec is written as a string, a table of named commands, or an array. |

## [launch]

Launch is the structured form of how an agent is started. Unknown keys in this section are errors.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | array of string | The agent executable and its arguments. |
| `cwd` | string |  |
| `env` | table of string |  |
| `prelude_timeout` | string | Go duration text, such as "90s". |

### [[launch.prelude]]

LaunchStep is one command that runs before the agent starts.

Write this array table once per entry, in order.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `argv` | array of string |  |
| `env` | table of string |  |
| `once` | boolean |  |
| `probe` | array of string |  |
| `retry` | `never` \| `idempotent` | RetryPolicy says whether a step that may have run can run again. |

## [list]

List controls the task listing.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | table of string | Extra columns, by name, each a template. |

## [merge]

Merge controls how a task lands.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clean` | boolean |  |
| `land` | `local` \| `pr` \| `push` | LandMode says where a landing goes. |
| `strategy` | `merge` \| `rebase` \| `squash` | MergeStrategy is the shape of the landed history. |
| `verify` | boolean |  |

## [policy]

Policy holds safety limits. Unknown keys in this section are errors.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deny` | array of string | Commands that hooks and automations may not run. |
| `landing` | string |  |
| `max_agents` | integer |  |
| `profile` | string |  |
| `protected` | array of string | Branch patterns that verbs must not move or delete. |
| `roots` | array of string | Folders an integrator may reach under the restricted profile. |
| `required_checks` | array of string |  |
| `review` | string |  |

### [policy.budget]

PolicyBudget limits one task or route.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cost` | string |  |
| `machine` | string |  |
| `tokens` | integer |  |
| `wall` | string |  |

## [project]

Project binds a folder to one herdsman project.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context` | boolean | Whether this folder is the project's context repository. |
| `id` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |

## [projects.<key>]

Overrides for one repository, keyed by its host and path. Each value has the shape of this message. A value may not hold projects or aliases.

Each value has the shape of `Config`, one level deep.

## [schema]

Schema says which version of this contract a file was written against.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | string | SemVer without a leading "v". A higher major than the binary's is refused. |

## [setup]

Setup prepares a new worktree.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | array of string | Ignored files copied into the worktree; none unless listed. |
| `install` | string |  |
| `ports` | integer | How many ports each task reserves. |
| `share` | array of string | Folders cloned copy-on-write from the main tree. |

## [suggest]

Suggest controls the suggestion catalogs.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` | array of string | Remote catalogs, each pinned to a commit. |

## [teardown]

Teardown controls how a task's processes and data stop.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `containers` | string |  |
| `grace` | integer | Seconds between the polite signal and the forced one. |
| `volumes` | `never` \| `on-clean` \| `on-teardown` | VolumePolicy says when a task's volumes are removed. |

## [worktree]

Worktree controls where task worktrees live.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | A template for the worktree's folder. |

## [automations]

Automations run an action when the daemon sees an event. The surface is experimental, so nothing fires until opted in, and each action also needs a person's approval of its exact checksum.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `experimental` | boolean | Must be true for any action to fire. |

### [automations.on.<key>]

Actions keyed by event kind, such as "merge.landed".

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `run` | string | A shell template. Event values reach the shell as variables, never as text. |
| `builtin` | string | A built-in action, such as "route pause". |
| `plugin` | string | A plugin's action, written "<plugin> <action>". |
| `timeout` | string | How long the action may run, such as "90s". |

## [retention]

Retention bounds the snapshots that undo can restore. The daemon reads it from the user file each time it applies a limit. A value that cannot be read stops the sweep and refuses new snapshots; nothing is deleted on a guess.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `undo` | string | How long a snapshot is kept: a Go duration or a count of days, as "720h" or "30d". The default is 30 days. |
| `cap` | string | The most all snapshots may hold: bytes, or a count with KiB, MiB, GiB or TiB, as "20GiB". The default is 20 GiB. A full cap refuses a new snapshot. |

## [runtime]

Runtime chooses where agents run. The section is strict: an unknown key stops the command, so a misspelled backend never falls through to a default.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` | string | "herdr-core" or "herdr-tui". Unset means the installation default, which `herdsman runtime default` prints. A route that exists keeps the backend it started on. |

### [runtime.core]

RuntimeCore says how to reach herdr-core.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | string | The hc program; a bare name is looked up on PATH. The default is "hc". |
| `socket` | string | An absolute socket path. Unset resolves the session through hc. |
| `session` | string | The core session. A socket and a session that contradict stop the run. |
| `connect_timeout` | string | How long to wait for core's socket, such as "5s". |
| `ready_timeout` | string | How long an agent may take to become ready, such as "90s". |
| `experimental` | boolean | Must be true while the backend ships as an experiment. |

### [runtime.app]

RuntimeApp says how to reach the native herdr app that shows the agents.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | string | The app program. The default is "herdr-app". |
| `home` | string | An absolute app home; unset means the user's main app. |
| `visibility_timeout` | string | How long to wait for an agent to appear in the app, such as "15s". |

### [runtime.tui_view]

RuntimeTuiView mirrors core agents in the Herdr TUI. It never changes the execution backend.

| Key | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | boolean | Mirror core agents in the TUI. Off unless set. |
| `socket` | string | The TUI's absolute socket path; required when enabled. |
